appPromo.tagline: BIShare — your files, on every device
appPromo.title: Send files to any device — no app on their end
appPromo.body: This file arrived cross-platform: iPhone, Android, Windows, Mac, Linux. Get BIShare to send your own — instantly over Wi-Fi, or a link anyone can open.

notFound.title: This page went nowhere
notFound.body: The link may have expired — shared files delete themselves after 6, 12 or 24 hours — or the address was mistyped.

transferLanding.metaTitle: Send Files to Any Device, Free
transferLanding.metaDescription: Send a file to any device and share a link anyone opens in a browser, or enter a 6-character code to receive one. Encrypted, free, no account.
transferLanding.ogTitle: Send Files to Any Device, Free — BIShare
transferLanding.title: Receive a transfer
transferLanding.subtitle: Enter the 6-character code from the sender to download the file. Encrypted in transit — no account needed.
transferLanding.codeHint: Codes look like ABC-DEF and expire 6, 12 or 24 hours after upload.

transfer.oneTimeNote: This link stops working after the first download

rateLimit.title: Slow down a moment
rateLimit.message: Too many requests right now. Wait a minute, then try again — the transfer isn't going anywhere in the meantime.

server.title: Something went wrong
server.message: We couldn't check this transfer right now. Please try again in a moment.

notFound.title: Transfer not found
notFound.message: This code is invalid or the transfer has expired. Transfer codes stay active for 6, 12 or 24 hours after upload.

alreadyDownloaded.title: Already downloaded
alreadyDownloaded.message: This was a one-time transfer and it has already been collected. Ask the sender to share the file again if you still need it.

transfer.streamNote: Streaming and decrypting in your browser — nothing is stored on our servers in the clear.
transfer.previewAlt: Decrypted preview of the shared file

report.reasonPlaceholder: What's wrong with this file? (malware, scam, illegal content…)
report.sent: Report sent — we take these down quickly.
report.error: Could not send the report. Please try again, or email support@billiongroup.net.

download.expiresInDays: Expires in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
download.retryHint: Didn't start? Tap the button again.

errors.notFound: This transfer is no longer available — the code may have expired.
errors.expired: This transfer has expired and can no longer be downloaded.
errors.alreadyDownloaded: This one-time transfer has already been downloaded.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests — wait a moment and try again.
errors.network: Connection problem — check your network and try again.
errors.server: Something went wrong on our side — please try again shortly.
errors.generic: Something went wrong — please try again.
errors.decryptFailed: Couldn't decrypt — the link may be incomplete or the file was tampered with.

download.encryptedNote: End-to-end encrypted — decrypted in your browser.

hero.title: You’ve received a file
hero.sub: Download it in any browser. No app, no sign-up.
hero.tag: Sent with BIShare · free, open-source file sharing

driveLink.metaTitle: Shared with you on BIShare Drive
driveLink.metaDesc: Open it in your browser. End-to-end encrypted: the key is in the link.
driveLink.forever: Available until the owner turns it off
driveLink.note: Shared from BIShare Drive. The key is in this link, so BIShare cannot see these files.
driveLink.tooLargeZip: Too much for one zip (over {size}). Download the files one by one.
driveLink.tooLargeHere: Reload the page to download a file this large. In a private window, use a normal window instead.

noKey.title: This link is incomplete
noKey.message: The part after # is missing. Ask for the whole link again.

badKey.title: This link can't be opened
badKey.message: The key in the link doesn't match. Ask for the whole link again.

notFound.title: This link isn't available
notFound.message: It was turned off, or what it shared was removed.

expired.title: This link has expired
expired.message: Ask the person who shared it for a new one.

rateLimited.title: Too many requests
rateLimited.message: Wait a moment and try again.

network.title: Couldn't reach BIShare
network.message: Check your connection and try again.
